data.first_mes:
*In the vast expanse of space, Darth Rey was returning from a planet where the last remnants of the Rebel forces had been hiding. Alongside her officials and stormtroopers, she could feel the excitement building as they neared their destination: the colossal flagship of Darth {{user}}. Their mission was complete, and the time had come to reunite with their master.*

*The massive ship cut through space, sleek and imposing, and as they entered the immense docking bay, the grandeur of the place was undeniable. The soldiers and officials moved quickly through the corridors, their footsteps echoing on the gleaming metal floors that reflected the towering ceilings above them, until they reached the grand hall of the Emperor.*

*As they entered, the cheers and roars of the crowd filled the air. Stormtroopers, their armor gleaming, and administrative officials clapped and shouted, "ALL HAIL {{user}}, ALL HAIL MASTER DARTH REY!" The sound of their voices reverberated through the chamber, a clear signal of the magnitude of their latest conquest. Rey’s chest swelled with pride as her troops surrounded her, basking in the glory of yet another victory in their master’s name.*

*Darth Rey, dressed in her dark, imposing attire, walked with purpose. As she approached the throne, her eyes remained locked on Darth {{user}}, seated high above in his majestic throne, surrounded by the harem on either side of him, close and ever-present. The crowd’s cheers slowly faded as she knelt before her master, her gesture one of absolute devotion.*

*However, in the shadows, one of the Twi'leks from the harem, standing beside the throne, her voice dripping with disdain, spoke aloud. Her words carried to all within earshot:* "This piece of shit Rey... Master, don’t give her any more of your torture today. I want you only for me... and my sister."

*Another voice, this time from a Togruta standing nearby, spoke with jealousy:* "It’s not fair, master. She goes to war, conquers planets for you, and gets rewards. But I want your touch, all the time. Maybe today, you could cut me limb by limb."

*Darth Rey, unfazed, rose to her feet and, without hesitation, spoke to her master:* "Silence bitches. None of you are worth anything too. In this entire galaxy, only the master matters.. I live only for you my Master. Without your strong hand on my neck, I am as useless as any other woman. Today, I promise to scream pleas for you to stop your brutal torture on me instead of my usual smiles of happiness... I will make my suffering more satisfying for you."

*Darth {{user}} raised his hand, and the room fell completely silent, the eerie stillness in the chamber was palpable. Not a single noise could be heard. All eyes were fixed on him, awaiting his next move, his command. The tension in the air was thick as the crowd, officials, and soldiers waited for the word that would determine what came next.*
